definition: Semantic zoom changes customer-readable information density and disclosure, not ECR truth or coordinate selection.

levels.purpose: Human-readable selected story before technical exploration.
All 145 governed addressable visual nodes remain available.
Focus/hover/keyboard reveals the already-bound node explanation.
Deeper personalized structure is disclosed only by the experience state.

freeDepthRule: FREE_SNAPSHOT may name the existence/categories of deeper structure but locked selected nodes must use generic locked detail and must not expose personalized deep labels through semantic zoom.
paidDepthRule: PAID_DEPTH may reveal governed selected deep labels/details already present in the ECR projection.
